name: Rack

length.label: Width (m)
length.desc: Rack width along local X, the run of bays. Drag the dot on either end face to resize in the viewport; while auto poles are on that drag snaps to whole bays, so the rack always ends on an upright.

depth.label: Depth (m)
depth.desc: Frame depth along local Z, front upright to back upright. Real frames are about 1.07 m (42 in), a little less than the pallet, so a 1.22 m (48 in) pallet overhangs each load beam. Drag the dot on either side face to resize in the viewport.

numShelves.label: Shelves
numShelves.desc: How many shelf levels sit above the floor. With the spacing below, this is what sets the total height.

shelfSpacing.label: Shelf spacing (m)
shelfSpacing.desc: Vertical gap between shelf levels. Leave room for the tallest load you mean to store, plus the truck reaching it.

enableAutoPoles.label: Auto poles
enableAutoPoles.desc: Stand an end frame at every bay along the width. Off leaves four corner posts only, which reads as a light shelving unit rather than pallet racking.

poleInterval.label: Bay width (m)
poleInterval.desc: Centre-to-centre spacing of the end frames along the width: one bay. Real bays are 2.4-2.7 m (96-108 in), two pallets wide. This is also the step a viewport resize of the width snaps to.

frameColor.label: Frame color
frameColor.desc: Tint of the uprights and the bracing between them.

beamColor.label: Beam color
beamColor.desc: Tint of the load beams under each shelf.

aisle.label: Aisle sign
aisle.desc: Text on a sign across the top of each end frame, such as AISLE 03. Leave it empty for no sign.

locationLabels.label: Location labels
locationLabels.desc: A location label on the front and back load beam of every bay at every level: a bar code, the bay number and the level, the way a warehouse system names each slot.
